points.quote: Desktop-only features, such as native terminals, are imported only from the desktop entry.
Web-only services are imported only from the web entry.
Each imports the shared `workbench.common.main.ts`, then its own list of services and contributions.
Platform differences sit behind service interfaces. ... Each platform then registers its own implementation
Anything not imported (transitively) from an entry point is never bundled or run.
Features register themselves on import ... The entry-point imports therefore effectively act as the feature manifest.
